title: Comment on: “An exploratory study on the effectiveness of AI detection tools in identifying AI-generated articles”
html: We read with interest the article by Grillo et al., which evaluates free artificial intelligence (AI) detection tools for distinguishing human-written from AI-generated text in oral and maxillofacial surgery.1 The study addresses a significant concern: as large language models (LLMs) become more advanced, scientific publishing must contend with the increasingly indistinct boundary between human-authored and AI-generated academic writing.
